crossRefs.note: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.
Yahweh is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.
For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy toward her, and they rejoiced with her.
For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.
For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light…
You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.
For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.
Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.
then God is gracious to him, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’
He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life will see the light.’
Behold, for peace I had great anguish, but you have in love for my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption; for…
For you threw me into the depths, in the heart of the seas. The flood was all around me. All your waves and your…
and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.

translations.web: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.
translations.bsb: For great is Your loving devotion to me; You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol.
translations.kjv: For great is thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.
translations.asv: For great is thy lovingkindness toward me; And thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.
